verdict.rationale: Modal is a cloud platform that processes customer code and data, so whether customer data is excluded from AI training is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence pack has no policy, setting, or opt-out about training on customer data. It covers only GPUs, pricing, SDKs, environments and observability, so the axis applies but nothing shows the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
